proposals.before: Her son Ji was then less than ten days old; she reared him within the inner quarters and never once left the house.
proposals.after: Her son Ji was then less than one hundred days old; she reared him within the inner quarters and never once left the house.
proposals.reason: 十旬 is ten ten-day periods, so 未十旬 means less than one hundred days old, not less than ten days old.

proposals.before: At that time her son Ji was not yet ten days old; she reared him within the inner chambers and never went out the door.
proposals.after: At that time her son Ji was not yet one hundred days old; she reared him within the inner chambers and never went out the door.
proposals.reason: 十旬 is ten ten-day periods, so 未十旬 means less than one hundred days old, not less than ten days old.

proposals.before: Though Zong was not a legitimate heir, her filial devotion overcame all bounds; though she failed to preserve her life, her resolve was fierce and her righteousness profound. Without special honor, how may we guide those adrift in shallow ways?
proposals.after: Though Zong was not a direct male heir, her filial devotion could not overcome her grief; though she failed to preserve her life, her resolve was fierce and her righteousness profound. Without special honor, how may we guide those adrift in shallow ways?
proposals.reason: 非嫡子 says she was not a direct male heir, while 孝不勝哀 says her filial devotion could not overcome her grief; the current wording reverses the latter relationship.

proposals.before: Lu then walked on foot with her aged mother-in-law to the Secretariat and reported the truth herself.
proposals.after: Lu then walked on foot with her aged mother-in-law to the Office of the Minister of Works and reported the truth herself.
proposals.reason: 司徒府 is the Office of the Minister of Works/Masses, not the Secretariat.

proposals.before: Lu then walked on foot with her aged mother-in-law to the Secretariat Director's office and reported the circumstances herself.
proposals.after: Lu then walked on foot with her aged mother-in-law to the Office of the Minister of Works and reported the circumstances herself.

decisions.reason: 旬 is a ten-day period, so 十旬 is one hundred days; 生未十旬 means Ji was not yet one hundred days old, and ‘ten days’ is a real mistranslation.
The same 未十旬 requires ‘not yet one hundred days old’ in the literal; ‘ten days’ undercounts by reading 旬 as a single day.

decisions.after: Though Zong was not a legitimate male heir, her filial devotion could not overcome her grief; though she departed from due moderation, her resolve was fierce and her righteousness profound. Without special honor, how may we guide those adrift in shallow ways?
decisions.reason: 孝不勝哀 means filial devotion could not overcome grief, so the before reverses that relation and must be fixed; but 乖俯就 is departure from mourning moderation (俯就), not ‘failed to preserve her life’, which the proposal still retains.

decisions.after: Lu then walked on foot with her aged mother-in-law to the Office of the Minister over the Masses and reported the truth herself.
decisions.reason: 司徒府 is the Situ’s office (Minister over the Masses/Education), not the Secretariat; the proposal’s ‘Minister of Works’ is 司空, so the office title still needs correction.

decisions.reason: Literal likewise misrenders 司徒府 as the Secretariat Director’s office; replacing it with Minister of Works still confuses 司徒 with 司空.
